modules.title: Pre-trip Inspection
modules.description: Inspect the motorcycle before riding and confirm it is roadworthy.
steps: Check for leaks, damage and obvious defects.
Inspect the wheels, tyres and controls.
Confirm lights, indicators, horn and brakes are working.

modules.title: Starting Procedure
modules.description: Mount, start and prepare the motorcycle safely.
steps: Mount the motorcycle correctly.
Start the engine only once the bike is ready.
Operate lights, indicators and horn as required.

modules.title: Lane Change
modules.description: Change lanes safely while checking mirrors and blind spots.
steps: Check mirrors and blind spots.
Signal your intention.
Steer safely into the selected lane and cancel the signal.

modules.title: Turning Left
modules.description: Perform a left turn while observing road users and markings.
steps: Check mirrors and blind spot to the left.
Signal and position correctly.
Yield to pedestrians and other traffic if required.

modules.title: Turning Right
modules.description: Handle right turns with safe observation and positioning.
steps: Check mirrors and blind spot to the right.
Signal early and position safely.
Yield to approaching traffic and pedestrians.

modules.title: Traffic Signals
modules.description: Respond correctly to traffic signals and officer directions.
steps: Observe the signal and surrounding traffic.
Stop or proceed only when it is safe.
Treat officer directions as legal instructions.

modules.title: Emergency Stop
modules.description: Stop as quickly and safely as possible under pressure.
steps: Maintain control and keep your eyes ahead.
Brake smoothly and progressively.
Stop within the required area without losing balance.
